description.zh: 通过独立的邮件 MCP 服务管理邮箱连接、查询邮件来源并采集邮件。在配置中添加账号、选择采集范围和保存方式；使用前需要有效的邮箱连接。
description.en: Use the independent Email MCP service to manage mailbox connections, inspect sources, and collect messages. Add accounts and choose collection scope and storage under Configuration; a valid mailbox connection is required.
